Event badges: current vs three options

Proposal for the CEO. Nothing is built until you pick. Every frame is a 390 x 844 phone and is clickable: tap Key to open the legend, tap a day row to open its Day view, use the arrows or Timeline to come back. Data is the fictional sample from docs/PRODUCT.md (today 15 Oct 2026). The sample has no notes, so three fictional notes were added (14, 13 and 10 Oct), and rows with a dashed pattern are illustrative busy days, not sample data. The language switch changes the frames; Phone width 360 narrows the Events column from 104 px to 74 px to show what happens on a small iPhone.

What differs today (audit of every placement)

PlaceVetSymptomsNote
Timeline rowplus + count ("+2")"!" or "!N"no badge
Key legendplus + sample "2""!" with no count (Timeline says "!2")not listed
Day view cardplus alone, no count"!" alone, no countplain grey document glyph, not a badge
+ Add sheetplus alone, next to the mint "+ Add" button"!" aloneplain glyph

The component and its CSS are already one; the glyph differs only by count / no count (and the note, which is not a badge at all). All options below fix that with one rule: the glyph is always the same; a number is added only where the badge stands for several events (Timeline, Key sample, the Symptoms card heading). A single vet card shows the glyph alone.

Third line: "+N"

Rows stay 44 px. Two lines of 18 px badges plus the 3 px gap are 39 px and fit; a third line cannot. Rule, same in every option: show badges in priority order (vet, symptoms, note, photo, F, D); if they do not fit in two lines, the last visible slot becomes a neutral "+N" chip (N = how many are hidden), built from existing tokens only (surface-tint, ink-2, line-strong). The row still opens the Day view, which lists everything, and the screen-reader summary of the row names all kinds. The third frame of each option shows it; switch Phone width to 360 px: with the six real kinds at 390 px they fit in two lines, at 360 px the sixth ("D") already overflows.
